title: W1-16 round 4 — progression and encumbrance
next_step: live probes: pinfight (save round trip on every state), burden, talisman, overloaded, feather, refusal

fix.1_save_pin: save/fight.js saveLoadout() writes equip_load_pinned off sim.player.equipLoadPinned; Engine._publishEquipLoad() is its sole writer; _restoreFightFromSave() restores the pin and its value from the blob instead of clearing it unconditionally. An old blob has the field undefined, which reads false = round-3 behaviour, so no save is retro-pinned.
fix.2_burden_worn: _recomputeBurden() now adds _handWeights() (weapon + shield + talisman) and skips right/left pack rows, exactly as _recomputeEquipLoad() does. RI-PRG07 §3 'equipped or not'. ONE OBJECT ONE WEIGHT: both ratios read the fight's own number.
fix.3_talisman: RI-PRG07 §2 term 4. carried.json ships a `talisman` slot row (root-speakers-rod, catalyst rod, 3.0 kg); cast-classes.json catalysts carry equip_weight (RI-PRG07 §4 = 3, enchanted_weapon 0 because it IS the weapon already weighed); _slotForItem resolves the slot; _finishEquipCommit calls MagicSystem.setCatalyst so the term changes focus cost and castNow's no_catalyst refusal, not only a number in a report.
fix.4_feather_clamp: engine._equipLoadOffset holds the live spell offset and _publishEquipLoad() clamps the SUM (pct = max(0, base + offset)), so apply and undo are exact inverses at every magnitude. magic/apply.js loadHandler goes through engine._addEquipLoadOffset. This also deletes the delta-origin state the round-3 verdict §C named as the root cause of C5.
fix.5_refusal_visible: _sayEquip() puts prose on engine.uiToast() (ui/hud.js E11) for on/off/unwearable/refused; the raw diagnostic naming 87 weapon ids stays on the event as ev.refused, the prose is ev.said.
